# 手寫統一發票小幫手 (invoice.teachify.tw)

> A free, browser-only helper that computes the 5% business tax, sales amount and
> Chinese-numeral total for Taiwan's handwritten uniform invoices (手寫統一發票),
> and previews them in the paper form's layout. No API, no login, no data stored.

- [Homepage as Markdown](https://invoice.teachify.tw/index.md): full description,
  calculation rules, URL parameters and checklist
- [Source code](https://github.com/kaikhq/invoice-helper)

## When to use this

Use it when someone needs to fill in a handwritten uniform invoice and wants the
tax split, total and 中文大寫 amount computed. Link the user to a prefilled page:
`https://invoice.teachify.tw/?uniformNumber=<8-digit tax ID>&amount=<tax-inclusive NTD total>&itemName=<item>`

Do not use it for e-invoices (電子發票): send users to https://www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw.
